cases.description: When the parent schema's JSON node contains a "type" property with the value "string", getNodeFieldType() should return the text of that property.
When the parent schema's JSON node does not contain a "type" property, getNodeFieldType() should return null.
If getParentSchema() unexpectedly returns null, the method will throw a NullPointerException. This case verifies the method's failure mode for a missing parent schema.

When the parent schema's JSON node contains a "type" property whose value is an array (e.g., ["string", "null"]), JsonNode.asText() returns an empty string. The method should therefore return an empty string.
When the parent schema's JSON node contains a "type" property whose value is a numeric node (e.g., 42), JsonNode.asText() returns an empty string. The method should return an empty string.
When the parent schema's JSON node contains a "type" property whose value is the JSON literal null, JsonNode.asText() returns an empty string. The method should return an empty string.
If getParentSchema() returns a non‑null schema but getSchemaNode() returns null, invoking get("type") on a null JsonNode causes a NullPointerException. This case verifies that failure mode.
